_comment: Pipeline health rules evaluated by observability/health_check.py (every minute by the Airflow DAG pipeline_health_checks, or standalone). A rule is breached when `metric <op> threshold`. `threshold_simulated_days` scales with SIMULATED_DAY_SECONDS. `on_missing: breach` treats 'no data at all' as a breach (e.g. the stream never started).

rules.name: vitals_stream_stale
rules.description: No vitals reading stored in the last 60s - producer, Kafka or speed layer is down

rules.name: speed_layer_down
rules.description: Speed-layer driver has not reported a heartbeat in 60s - Spark job stopped or crashed

rules.name: live_summary_stale
rules.description: Real-time serving view (vitals_live_summary) not updated in 90s

rules.name: lab_feed_stale
rules.description: No new lab results file for 2.5 simulated days - daily batch source is late

rules.name: batch_backlog
rules.description: More than 2 lab files are waiting for the batch layer - Airflow/batch job is falling behind

rules.name: batch_job_failing
rules.description: More than 20% of batch-layer runs failed in the last 30 minutes

rules.name: data_quality_rejects_high
rules.description: More than 5% of consumed readings rejected as invalid - producer or schema problem

rules.name: ward_abnormal_rate_high
rules.description: More than 30% of readings in the last 5 minutes are abnormal (expected ~10%) - ward-wide event or faulty sensors
